data.name: Mehrana
data.gender_notes: Mehrana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is radiant, shining light, or a garden of blooming flowers. The name Mehrana carries the meaning “Radiant, shining light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Arabic. Parents who choose Mehrana usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner light of the soul and the divine light of God
data.etymology: Mehrana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, shining light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehrana total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: مهرانہ

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mehrana" holds deep roots in Persian and Islamic culture, evoking images of radiance, light, and beauty. In ancient Persian culture, Mehrana was a goddess of love, fertility, and the harvest. In Islamic tradition, Mehrana is associated with the concept of 'Mehr', which means 'giver or giver of wealth'. This can symbolize abundance, generosity, and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: Mehrana holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the light and love that exists within each individual. It serves as a reminder to be radiant, shining forth one's inner light and spreading love and kindness to all. In the Islamic faith, this spiritual intention aligns with the teachings of Islam, which emphasizes love, compassion, and generosity towards others. By embracing the spiritual meaning of Mehrana, one can strive to be a beacon of light in the world, illuminating the path for others and inspiring them with love and kindness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Radiant, shining light" symbolizes One who is radiant, shining light, or a garden of blooming flowers. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mehrana serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of radiant, shining light.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Mehrana was a Persian princess mentioned in the Shahnameh, the national epic of Iran, written by the poet Ferdowsi in the 10th century.

platforms: Mehrana is a common name on social media platforms such as Instagram and Facebook.
